BandProblem.description: Band structure of a photonic crystal along a k-path.

polarization.description: 2D only: TE = E in plane, TM = E along z.
polarization.title: Polarization

BandProblem.title: BandProblem

CircuitProblem.description: A netlist of components with S-parameter models; solves the circuit S-matrix.
CircuitProblem.title: CircuitProblem

ConstantIndex.description: Wavelength-independent complex refractive index n + ik.

n_real.description: Real part of the refractive index.
n_real.title: N Real

ConstantIndex.title: ConstantIndex

Cylinder.description: Flat-ended cylinder with axis along z.
Cylinder.title: Cylinder

DesignRegion.description: A box whose permittivity is free: density 0 -> material_low, 1 -> material_high.

size_nm.description: Box size; z is ignored in 2D.
size_nm.title: Size Nm

min_feature_nm.description: Minimum solid and void feature size, imposed with lengthscale penalties (needs filter_radius_nm >= min_feature_nm / 2).
min_feature_nm.title: Min Feature Nm

symmetry.description: Mirror symmetry: 'x' = symmetric under x -> -x about the region centre, 'y' likewise.
symmetry.title: Symmetry

DesignRegion.title: DesignRegion

DeviceProblem.description: A photonic device (waveguides, couplers, gratings, ...) characterised by its S-matrix.
DeviceProblem.title: DeviceProblem

Drude.description: eps(w) = eps_inf - wp^2 / (w^2 + i*gamma*w), energies in eV.
Drude.title: Drude

DrudeLorentz.description:
eps(w) = eps_inf - wp^2/(w^2 + i g w) + sum_j d_j w0_j^2 / (w0_j^2 - w^2 - i G_j w).

The form FDTD needs for auxiliary-differential-equation dispersion.
Fit one to measured data with :func:`lightsmith.materials_fit.fit_drude_lorentz`.
DrudeLorentz.title: DrudeLorentz

FarFieldRequest.description:
Differential scattering cross section dC_sca/dOmega on a theta x phi grid.

theta is measured from the incident direction; phi is the azimuth around it,
measured from the incident polarization (phi=0 is the E-plane, 90 the H-plane).
FarFieldRequest.title: FarFieldRequest

FieldIntensityTerm.description: Mean |field|^2 (Hz for TE, Ez for TM) in a box, with one port mode as the source.

aggregate.description: Over wavelengths. 'min' (worst-case for maximize) uses a smooth minimum.
aggregate.title: Aggregate

size_nm.description: Box size; zero sizes select a line or point.
size_nm.title: Size Nm

FieldIntensityTerm.title: FieldIntensityTerm

GdsLayout.description: Import geometry from a GDS file: each layer/datatype is extruded with a material.
GdsLayout.title: GdsLayout

component.description: Registered compact model name, e.g. 'waveguide', 'mmi1x2', or 'sparams:<file>'.
component.title: Component

reduced.description: Coordinates in units of the reciprocal lattice vectors.
reduced.title: Reduced

coherent.description: False for thick incoherent layers (e.g. a 1 mm substrate slab).
coherent.title: Coherent

LayerStackProblem.description: Planar multilayer: reflection/transmission/absorption vs wavelength and angle.

layers.description: From the superstrate side to the substrate side.
layers.title: Layers

angles_deg.description: Angles of incidence in the superstrate.
angles_deg.title: Angles Deg

LayerStackProblem.title: LayerStackProblem

LayeredSphere.description:
Core-shell / multilayer sphere. The particle's `material` is the core;
`shells` are listed from the inside out.
LayeredSphere.title: LayeredSphere

LibraryMaterial.description:
Measured n, k bundled with lightsmith, e.g. ``{"kind": "library", "name": "Au",
"dataset": "Johnson-Christy"}``. Linear interpolation in n and k, no extrapolation.

Names and datasets accept aliases ("gold", "JC") and are stored in canonical form;
an omitted dataset is filled with the material's default so the spec stays
reproducible. See :func:`list_materials`.
LibraryMaterial.title: LibraryMaterial

ModeProblem.description: Eigenmodes of a waveguide cross-section (xy plane), propagation along +z.

target_neff.description: Search near this effective index (default: highest index).
target_neff.title: Target Neff

bend_radius_nm.description: Bend about the y axis; None = straight.
bend_radius_nm.title: Bend Radius Nm

ModeProblem.title: ModeProblem

NearFieldRequest.description: Total electric field on a square plane through the scene.

offset_nm.description: Position of the plane along its normal.
offset_nm.title: Offset Nm

NearFieldRequest.title: NearFieldRequest

OptimizationProblem.description: Topology optimisation of a device: maximise sum(weight * term) (minimise terms with goal='minimize').

backend.description: Any backend with differentiable=True and differentiable_solve (see lightsmith.inverse).
backend.title: Backend

OptimizationProblem.title: OptimizationProblem

method.description: mma = globally convergent MMA (monotone; Svanberg 2002); adam; lbfgsb = SciPy L-BFGS-B.
method.title: Method

lengthscale_weight.description: Penalty weight of the min-feature constraints.
lengthscale_weight.title: Lengthscale Weight

lengthscale_from_beta.description: Apply min-feature penalties once beta >= this.
lengthscale_from_beta.title: Lengthscale From Beta

ftol.description: Stop when the relative improvement over 10 iterations is below this.
ftol.title: Ftol

material.description: Particle material (the core for layered spheres).
material.title: Material

PeriodicProblem.description: A 1D/2D-periodic stack of patterned layers under plane-wave illumination.

lattice_a2_nm.description: None for 1D gratings: periodic along a1, invariant perpendicular to it; shapes are sampled along the line through the origin in the a1 direction.
lattice_a2_nm.title: Lattice A2 Nm

layers.description: From the superstrate side to the substrate side.
layers.title: Layers

PeriodicProblem.title: PeriodicProblem

size_nm.description: Zero along the port normal. In 2D devices z may also be zero, e.g. (0, w, 0) for an x-normal port.
size_nm.title: Size Nm

direction.description: Direction of propagation *into* the device along the normal.
direction.title: Direction

Prism.description: A 2D profile in the xy plane extruded from z_min to z_max (with optional sidewall angle).

sidewall_angle_deg.description: 0 = vertical; positive = narrower at the top.
sidewall_angle_deg.title: Sidewall Angle Deg

Prism.title: Prism

SParameterTerm.description: |S[out <- in]|^2 (power) of port modes, e.g. transmission o1 -> o2 or reflection o1 -> o1.

aggregate.description: Over wavelengths. 'min' (worst-case for maximize) uses a smooth minimum.
aggregate.title: Aggregate

SParameterTerm.title: SParameterTerm

Simulation.description: A complete scattering problem. Serialisable to/from JSON.

medium_index.title: Medium Index

orientation_average.description: Average cross sections over all particle orientations.

options.description: Solver options keyed by method or backend name, e.g. {'dda': {'dipoles_per_diameter': 20}}.
options.title: Options

Spheroid.description: Spheroid with symmetry axis along z.
